metrics.method: Full history 2025-08-25 to 2026-09-03: 1808 non-service messages (1072 client / 736 our side). client_questions_total = client messages containing '?'. Strict first-reply-by-anyone lag is excellent (median 0.03h, mean 1.6h, p90 3.2h) and yields only 1 breach; unanswered_over_24h=4 instead counts questions with no SUBSTANTIVE answer inside 24h (invoice split 2026-07-19 43h; Zelle-not-working 2026-08-07 39h; 'What our update?' after a broken 2-hour promise 2026-08-13; and the final '???' of 2026-09-03 never answered). max_team_silence_days measures consecutive days with zero human outbound from our side, excluding automated leak-scan broadcasts (raw longest gap including them is 8.1d, 2025-12-23 to 2025-12-31). Promises = explicit dated commitments made by our side; 3 further promises were unverifiable from the transcript and are excluded from kept/lapsed.

what_client_wanted: Aggressive, visible growth she could feel — 'Let's make this impactful' (2025-08-25) and 'Let's really push Today Team these last few days left of month... 📈📈📈' (2026-03-28).

Her name cleaned off leak sites for brand reasons, not just volume takedowns — 'My biggest thing is when they type and My Name with Naked doesn't show any of that type of content for branding purposes' (2025-08-29).
Her Instagram and Facebook protected and verified above all else — 'Just def want page protected at all costs' and 'Also get it Verified since I'm now just getting back active' (2025-09-15).

Her content boundaries respected without having to re-litigate them — 'minus pussy content I see, Sextapes, and solo play being that content I don't do!' (2025-08-27) and 'No exception for him / Just something I won't do' (2026-02-24).
what_worked: The initial DMCA sweep and the honest weekly cadence behind it — 'Insaneeee / But glad we cleaned it all up / Thank Youuuu 🙏🏽' (2025-08-28) and 'Yes! Yes! / Looking much more clear' (2025-09-03). Weekly leak reports remain the one thing we have never stopped sending.

The single report + 14-day game plan Sophie delivered — 'Thank you for this Report... I think we are on the right track / Moving Upward 📈 / Stradgey makes sense' (2025-09-23). It is the only strategic artefact she has ever received and she engaged with it immediately.

Chatters who set boundaries with her up front rather than after selling — King Choy asking her limits before taking FT requests drew 'Thank Youuu / For communicating that with me 🙏🏽🙏🏽🙏🏽' (2025-08-30); the same instinct is why pausing chats during her lives ('we wanna make sure no fan would suspect you're using chatters', 2025-12-19) landed so well.
top_fix: Give every client one named owner who is accountable for a standing biweekly stats report and call, and make a written handover to the client mandatory whenever anyone leaves — staff or vendor team. Lauryn lost her relationship manager silently on 2025-10-09 and her entire chat team silently on 2026-06-10; from those two moments nobody owned her numbers, no report was ever sent again, the Facebook block went a full year unresolved, and the only remaining contact she had with us was an invoice chase.
